bronze.label: Bronze
bronze.note: A common pick. Barely leaves the surface.

silver.label: Silver
silver.note: Still a popular route, but a step past the obvious.

gold.label: Gold
gold.note: Solid middling depth. You had company.

platinum.label: Platinum
platinum.note: Sharper than average. Fewer players go here.

diamond.label: Diamond
diamond.note: Uncommon. A minority of players land here.

master.label: Master
master.note: Genuinely obscure. Most players never think of this.

challenger.label: Challenger
challenger.note: The rarest accepted depth. Almost nobody wrote this.
